# 74182 - Look-ahead carry generator

Package DIP-16 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74182.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74182.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 36 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74182 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74182.png) | ![74182 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-74182.png) | ![74182 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-74182.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 16 | VCC | power |  | +5 V |
| 8 | GND | ground |  |  |
| 3 | /G0 | input |  | carry generate input, active low (alternative name Y0) |
| 1 | /G1 | input |  | carry generate input, active low (Y1) |
| 14 | /G2 | input |  | carry generate input, active low (Y2) |
| 5 | /G3 | input |  | carry generate input, active low (Y3) |
| 4 | /P0 | input |  | carry propagate input, active low (X0) |
| 2 | /P1 | input |  | carry propagate input, active low (X1) |
| 15 | /P2 | input |  | carry propagate input, active low (X2) |
| 6 | /P3 | input |  | carry propagate input, active low (X3) |
| 13 | Cn | input |  | carry input |
| 12 | Cn+x | output | totem-pole |  |
| 11 | Cn+y | output | totem-pole |  |
| 9 | Cn+z | output | totem-pole |  |
| 10 | /G | output | totem-pole | carry generate output, active low (Y) |
| 7 | /P | output | totem-pole | carry propagate output, active low (X) |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 12 | Cn+x = G0 OR (P0 AND Cn) | Datasheet equation, with G0 = NOT G0', P0 = NOT P0'. Function table: high when G0' low, or P0' low and Cn high; low otherwise. |
| 11 | Cn+y = G1 OR (P1 AND G0) OR (P1 AND P0 AND Cn) | Datasheet equation (G = NOT G', P = NOT P'). |
| 9 | Cn+z = G2 OR (P2 AND G1) OR (P2 AND P1 AND G0) OR (P2 AND P1 AND P0 AND Cn) | Datasheet equation (G = NOT G', P = NOT P'). |
| 10 | /G = NOT (G3 OR (P3 AND G2) OR (P3 AND P2 AND G1) OR (P3 AND P2 AND P1 AND G0)) | Datasheet: G' = (G3 + P3G2 + P3P2G1 + P3P2P1G0)'. Low when the group generates a carry. |
| 7 | /P = NOT (P3 AND P2 AND P1 AND P0) | Low only when P3', P2', P1', P0' are all low. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.8 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | SN74182 recommended: VCC 4.75-5.25 V, IOH -800 uA, IOL 16 mA, TA 0-70 C. Inputs load unequally: IIL Cn -3.2 mA, P3' -4.8, P2' -6.4, P0'/P1'/G3' -8, G0'/G2' -14.4, G1' -16 mA (several standard loads). |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm; the datasheet gives one figure for all paths.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| any | any | PLH | 11 | 17 |
| any | any | PHL | 15 | 22 |

## Not known

- No minimum propagation delays printed (path-delay function uses 0 ns).

## Notes

The same circuit serves active-high data with the alternative names Y0-Y3, X0-X3, Cn', Y, X: Cn+x' = (Y0(X0 + Cn))' etc., as printed on page 7-282.

## Sources

- [TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, SN54182/SN74182 (bulletin DL-S 7611823, Dec 1972, rev. Oct 1976)](https://bitsavers.mirrorservice.org/components/ti/_dataBooks/1976_TI_The_TTL_Data_Book_2ed/07.pdf) - 7-282 to 7-284 (PDF pages 281-283); SN74182
